title: Blockchain equities: beyond the crypto cycle
summary: Blockchain is moving beyond a pure crypto-price trade, with stablecoins, tokenisation, staking and artificial intelligence / high performance computing (AI/HPC) creating additional sources of economic exposure across the value chain.
